ranked.headline: Neighborhood topology and bias-aware statistics sharpen spatial tissue architecture
ranked.summary: Spatial alignment benchmarks and size-bias-corrected aggregation statistics now set reliability limits for cross-platform tissue architecture analysis.

ranked.headline: Posterior inference is refining detection of regulatory variants and genetic effects
ranked.summary: Pooled designs, trio models, and genome-wide annotations now feed posterior inference over regulatory and genetic effects.

ranked.headline: MD and AI methods resolve folding, binding pathways, and conformational energetics
ranked.summary: Ensemble-level sampling now links folding landscapes, binding routes, and mutation-level entropy to structural readouts across diverse protein systems.

ranked.headline: Long-read sequencing resolves genome variation and regulatory isoform diversity
ranked.summary: Long-read assemblies and transcript data now reach haplotype-resolved, population-scale and isoform-level regulatory readouts within one framework.

ranked.headline: Multi-omics plus network structure to rank candidate genes, metabolites and pathways
ranked.summary: Preprints now pair transcriptomic, metabolomic, and microbiome profiles with interaction networks to prioritize candidate functions and regulators.

ranked.headline: Mechanistic simulations couple physical mechanisms to spatial cell readouts
ranked.summary: Explicit physical and regulatory mechanisms are now being tested against measured spatial structure in tissues, tumoroids, and immune cell populations.

ranked.headline: Chromosome-level and haplotype-resolved assemblies reveal plant genome evolution
ranked.summary: Chromosome-level and pangenome assemblies now underpin evolutionary and functional inference across plant lineages, from sesame to buckwheat.

ranked.headline: Multimodal fusion and feature selection for cancer prognosis across omics and EHR data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints test fusion, feature selection, and benchmarking for censored cancer outcomes, including additive rather than synergistic glioma gains.

ranked.headline: Read-level tools extend microbial profiling across platforms and sample types
ranked.summary: Host-centric saliva WGS reads yield robust oral microbiome profiles, suggesting existing human sequencing data can support microbiome analysis.

ranked.headline: Public tools for mining microbial genomes and metagenomes for pathogen and resistance…
ranked.summary: Metagenomic and pathogen-genome analyses are now packaged as public, reusable resources for virulence, resistance, and dark-proteome mining.

ranked.headline: Protein language and structure models predict disorder, binding and localization
ranked.summary: Protein language model embeddings and graph networks now target disorder, localization, phase separation and ligand binding simultaneously.

ranked.headline: Generative and Dirichlet-prior models are reshaping single-cell representation learning
ranked.summary: Diffusion, flow-matching and prior-constrained autoencoders now embed biological structure directly into single-cell generative and representational objectives.

ranked.headline: Reference-based methods assign cell identity across single-cell, spatial and bulk data
ranked.summary: Re-analysis of the human TF Atlas and new spatial and kidney cell-typing tools test reference-based assignment in practice.

ranked.headline: Learned predictors coupled to experimental restraints, QM data, and sequence models
ranked.summary: Preprints and published work now couple protein language models, AlphaFold priors, and ML potentials to restraints and experimental data.

ranked.headline: Structure-informed models struggle to generalize TCR specificity to unseen peptides
ranked.summary: IMMREP25 shows top TCR:pMHC methods reach only modest macro-AUC on unseen peptides, while label provenance in epitope data is now under audit.

ranked.headline: Open tools speed sequencing QC, basecalling, and large-scale biological model training
ranked.summary: Biological datasets now routinely exceed system memory, so data access rather than model computation is becoming the training bottleneck.

ranked.headline: Generative and transport models reconstruct single-cell state transitions from snapshot…
ranked.summary: Single-cell dynamics models now link snapshot transcriptomes, time-lapse morphology, and cell-cell communication into inferred state trajectories.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking variant predictors and genomic methods by downstream clinical consequences
ranked.summary: Recent preprints score predictors and heritability methods by clinical evidence yield and polygenic risk downstream effects, not internal fit alone.

ranked.headline: K-mer tools operate on raw reads without assembly or against pangenome references
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply k-mer indexes to raw reads for phylogeny, genotyping, error correction, and genome profiling.

ranked.headline: ML models link biological structure to drug responses, side effects and mechanisms
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study apply learned models to biological structure to predict molecular and clinical outcomes.

ranked.headline: Foundation models derive quantitative brain aging and stimulation response readouts
ranked.summary: Foundation models now output intervention-sensitive metrics, such as EEG brain age change and predicted DBS response, not just aging clocks.

ranked.headline: EEG energy landscapes and learned features track cortical network state dynamics
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications apply energy landscapes, interpretable learned features, and recurrence analysis to cortical EEG state.

ranked.headline: Supervised and robust learning methods address confounding in genomic inference tasks
ranked.summary: Recent items apply positive-unlabeled, SVM, and random forest methods to selection, prediction, imputation, and geolocation problems.

ranked.headline: Proteome-scale prediction of homo- and heterodimer structures extends AlphaFold coverage
ranked.summary: Confidence-tiered AlphaFold models now span quaternary assemblies and domain-level classification across proteomes and Swiss-Prot.

ranked.headline: Generative and deep learning models expand proteome-wide and subcellular image analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool apply generative and morphology-aware deep learning to image-based cell biology at multiple scales.

ranked.headline: Biological dynamics modeled as network flows and Koopman operators across scales
ranked.summary: Counterfactual flow and operator-theoretic models are emerging to link network interventions with connectome and multiome dynamics.

ranked.headline: Graph and transport models align, integrate and domain-partition single-cell data
ranked.summary: Learned graph and transport structures are being applied to integrate, cluster and spatially partition high-dimensional single-cell measurements.

ranked.headline: Analysis choices and topology reshape inferred protein conformational states
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show representation, topology, and network choices shape how MD and structural data are read as conformational states.

ranked.headline: Docking and MD pipelines add explicit context to biomolecular interaction prediction
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study pair template pruning, docking, and molecular dynamics to sharpen predicted peptide, antibody fragment, and receptor…

ranked.headline: Predicted structures and pangenome graphs resolve viral and eukaryotic evolution
ranked.summary: Structural models and pangenome graphs now resolve evolutionary relationships across viral, primate, and aphid genomes.

ranked.headline: Re-engineered Nextflow and R workflow systems target reproducible omics analysis
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published R/Bioconductor system re-architect established omics pipelines for portable, reproducible execution.

ranked.headline: Structure-based tools tested on mutation effects, conformational sampling and water sites
ranked.summary: Structure-aware predictors and representations are being scored against defined questions in mutation, dynamics and binding-site biology.

ranked.headline: Computational methods infer rare genotypes and mosaic mutations from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Deeper sequencing and pangenome references are pushing inference of rare and mosaic variants from bulk, single-cell, and cell-free data.

ranked.headline: Probabilistic priors and observation models shape inferred cell-lineage phylogenies
ranked.summary: Recent work shows birth-death priors bias single-cell lineage tree inference, making prior and observation model choice consequential for tree structure.

ranked.headline: Maternal blood transcriptome dynamics and RVFV infection of trophoblast stem cells
ranked.summary: Pregnancy-associated molecular programs and placental pathogen responses are now resolved at transcript and single-cell resolution.

ranked.headline: Statistical and neural methods for grouped microbiome data analysis
ranked.summary: Microbiome studies need inference and classification tools that handle sparse, grouped data while remaining statistically interpretable.

ranked.headline: Structure and LLM embeddings extend sensitive homology detection and annotation
ranked.summary: Recent tools pair LLM embeddings, structural tokens, and machine learning to improve sequence homology search, annotation, and alignment filtering.

ranked.headline: Protein language models applied to proteomic FDR control and enzyme function prediction
ranked.summary: Protein language models are being evaluated as decoy generators, EC number predictors, and components of neural database search in mass spectrometry.

ranked.headline: AI-predicted coat proteins assembled into capsid and genome-in-capsid models
ranked.summary: Capsid-scale modeling now extends from single-protein AlphaFold predictions to genome organization inside the viral capsid.

ranked.headline: Long-read sequencing enables reference-based and read-level DNA methylation profiling
ranked.summary: Nanopore, PacBio and HiFi reads now support methylation calling across metagenomes, vertebrate promoters and targeted amplicons with read-level phasing.
